description: Independent STATUS-ESPN-1 complete-envelope expectations authored without consulting new decoder or consumer outputs.

cases.because: Ordinary captured names retain their phase and label semantics; pregame zeros remain reported placeholders.
Halftime identity wins over a still-running display clock; a normal second-half display clock remains verbatim.
An unambiguous exception is classified before its abbreviation is displayed and overrides generic phase without rewriting provider_state.
A post phase is placement evidence, not proof of a completed match or final score.
Missing phase does not invent scheduled; unsupported phases remain diagnostic strings and cannot create progress.
Recognized identities must agree. A final/cancelled contradiction never becomes either an ordinary final or live progress.
Generic phase and completion booleans constrain ordinary status identities; completed alone never establishes a final.
Pre/in can stand alone when no explicit identity contradicts them. Halftime is still recognized through text without a named status.
The selected whole status object owns interpretation; an empty or non-object competition status falls back, a nonempty unusable object does not.
The same parser accepts scalar and displayValue zeros, preserves absent sides and never substitutes value for missing displayValue.
Contract-bound independent sides reject non-scores without inventing zeros or accepting presentation strings.
Display clock, detail and raw extra score/status fields do not establish completion or manufacture shootout/aggregate mappings.
Malformed source JSON remains a per-case unknown rather than a protocol exception; malformed scores remain absent.
Direct/rehydrated Match values use the same classifier and parser, with canonical exception labels preserving meaning through the seam.
The normalized seam does not infer final from post or preserve a contradictory live phase; reporting scores stays independent.
A source phase beyond the existing100-character feed limit supplies no recognized phase; an overlong display clock falls back without truncation or fabricating elapsed time.
Accepted raw live displayClock text does not participate in identity classification, including text which would be a terminal token in an identity field.

Canonical state survives raw-to-normalized serialization without reinterpreting display text. Phase inconsistency or unsupported bound state fails to unknown; absent/null state retains legacy inference.
